sources.title: Ishowbackup/Huihui-gemma-4-12B-it-abliterated · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: huihui-ai/Huihui-gemma-4-12B-it-abliterated This is an uncensored version of google/gemma-4-12B-it created with abliteration (see remove-refusals-with-transformers to know more about it). This is a crude, proof-of-concept implementation to remove refusals from an LLM model without using TransformerLens.

sources.title: huihui_ai/gemma-4-abliterated
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models are designed to deliver frontier-level performance at each size. They are well-suited for reasoning, agentic workflows, coding, and multimodal understanding.

sources.title: huihui-ai/Huihui-gemma-4-12B-it-abliterated
sources.snippet: Summary This model is an uncensored version of Google's Gemma 4 12B it model, created using abliteration to remove refusals. It is available on Hugging Face and Ollama, with warnings about sensitive outputs.
